Class Debugger.CollectingCompositeNode

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.tools.debugger.Debugger.CollectingCompositeNode
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.intellij.xdebugger.frame.XCompositeNode, com.intellij.xdebugger.Obsolescent, org.jetbrains.concurrency.Obsolescent
Enclosing class:
Debugger
private static final class Debugger.CollectingCompositeNode extends Object implements com.intellij.xdebugger.frame.XCompositeNode
An XCompositeNode that collects computed children as name = value lines into a StringBuilder, bridging the asynchronous children callback to the synchronous variable-listing tool. Each child's value is rendered synchronously via its own presentation callback (values are already resolved by the time addChildren is invoked).
Author:
anahata
